LESSON: RESPONDING TO

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Responding to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Responding to. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. ask questions to seek clarity on instructions
2. demonstrate willingness to answer questions and follow instructions and groups.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. ask questions to seek clarity on instructions
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to ask questions to seek clarity on instructions. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate willingness to answer questions and follow instructions and groups.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate willingness to answer questions and follow instructions and groups. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Responding to using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Responding to.
2. Explain Responding to to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Responding to.
4. Show that you can: ask questions to seek clarity on instructions
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Responding to. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Responding to important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. ask questions to seek clarity on instructions
2. demonstrate willingness to answer questions and follow instructions and groups.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
